'''Diyaz''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|Male]] [[Agent/Legends|agent]] with the [[Republic Strategic Information Service|Strategic Information Service]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. Diyaz was part of a task force along with [[Special Agent/Legends|Special Agent]] [[Korol Tander]] and [[Commando/Legends|commandos]] from [[Blackstar Squad]] who destroyed the files of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic's]] secret [[Power Guard Enhancement System|Power Guard Project]] after it was stolen by the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Sadic]].
